# Card deck

[← Chat heads](chat_heads.md) · [All examples](../EXAMPLES.md) · [Your first animation →](first_animation.md)

<img src="../gifs/card_deck.gif" width="300" alt="Card deck">

Swipe cards away: the top card tilts as you drag, a stamp fades in, and the next card grows into place.

Reanimated docs: [fundamentals/handling-gestures](https://docs.swmansion.com/react-native-reanimated/docs/fundamentals/handling-gestures)

## What to look at

- One `translation` shared value drives everything. The top card's position and tilt, the stamps' opacity, and the next card's scale are all `interpolate`d from it.
- A fling past a third of the width, or a fast one, throws the card off with `withTiming`. Otherwise it springs back with the release velocity.
- DartNative's `Stack` matches children by index, so each index keeps its depth and only the card shown there changes.

## Code

The screen comes first, then the components it uses. Shared helpers (`DemoPage`, `Section`, `Stage`, `Palette`, `Buttons`, `ChoiceChips`, `LabeledSlider`) live in `example_app/lib/src/common/` and only do layout.

### `lib/src/screens/card_deck_screen.dart`

```dart
import 'package:dartnative/dartnative.dart';
import 'package:reanimated_dartnative/reanimated_dartnative.dart';

import '../common/common.dart';
import '../components/swipe_card.dart';

/// A swipeable card deck: the top card follows your finger and tilts, a
/// stamp fades in as you commit, the next card grows into place, and a
/// fling sends the card off screen at the speed you threw it (otherwise it
/// springs back, keeping your velocity).
class CardDeckScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const CardDeckScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<CardDeckScreen> createState() => _CardDeckScreenState();
}

class _CardDeckScreenState extends State<CardDeckScreen> with ReanimatedStateMixin {
  static const cards = [
    ('Springs', Palette.purple),
    ('Decay', Palette.blue),
    ('Keyframes', Palette.pink),
    ('Layout', Palette.yellow),
    ('Sensors', Color(0xFF7FD1FA)),
  ];

  late final translation = useSharedValue(Offset.zero);
  List<int> order = List.generate(cards.length, (i) => i);
  String last = '';

  void onPanEnd(DragEndDetails details, double width) {
    final v = details.velocity.pixelsPerSecond;
    final t = translation.value;
    final throwRight = t.dx > width / 3 || v.dx > 900;
    final throwLeft = t.dx < -width / 3 || v.dx < -900;
    if (!throwRight && !throwLeft) {
      translation.set(withSpring(Offset.zero, velocity: v, dampingRatio: 0.6, duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 500)));
      return;
    }
    final target = Offset((throwRight ? 1.6 : -1.6) * width, t.dy + v.dy * 0.15);
    translation.set(withTiming(
      target,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 280),
      easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad),
      callback: (finished) {
        if (!finished || !mounted) return;
        setState(() {
          last = '${throwRight ? 'Liked' : 'Passed'} ${cards[order.first].$1}';
          order = [...order.skip(1), order.first];
        });
        translation.value = Offset.zero;
      },
    ));
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final width = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width - 64;
    return DemoPage(
      title: 'Card deck',
      docs: 'fundamentals/handling-gestures',
      child: Column(
        children: [
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          // One detector over the deck: the top card moves by transform,
          // and its touch area stays where it was laid out.
          GestureDetector(
            behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
            onPanStart: (_) => cancelAnimation(translation),
            onPanUpdate: (d) => translation.value = translation.value + d.delta,
            onPanEnd: (d) => onPanEnd(d, width),
            child: SizedBox(
              width: width,
              height: width * 1.3 + 30,
              child: Stack(
                children: [
                  SizedBox(width: width, height: width * 1.3 + 30),
                  // Back to front. A Stack matches children by index, so each
                  // index keeps its depth and only the card shown there changes.
                  for (var depth = order.length - 1; depth >= 0; depth--)
                    Positioned(
                      left: 0,
                      top: 0,
                      child: SwipeCard(
                        translation: translation,
                        depth: depth,
                        width: width,
                        color: cards[order[depth]].$2,
                        title: cards[order[depth]].$1,
                      ),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          Text(last, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16)),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

### `lib/src/components/swipe_card.dart`

```dart
import 'package:dartnative/dartnative.dart';
import 'package:reanimated_dartnative/reanimated_dartnative.dart';

import '../common/common.dart';

/// A card of the swipeable deck. The top card follows [translation] and
/// tilts with it; the card under it ([depth] 1) grows into place as the top
/// one moves away; deeper cards wait behind.
class SwipeCard extends StatefulWidget {
  const SwipeCard({
    super.key,
    required this.translation,
    required this.depth,
    required this.width,
    required this.color,
    required this.title,
  });

  final SharedValue<Offset> translation;
  final int depth;
  final double width;
  final Color color;
  final String title;

  @override
  State<SwipeCard> createState() => _SwipeCardState();
}

class _SwipeCardState extends State<SwipeCard> with ReanimatedStateMixin {
  late final style = useAnimatedStyle(() {
    final t = widget.translation.value;
    switch (widget.depth) {
      case 0:
        return AnimatedStyle(
          translateX: t.dx,
          translateY: t.dy,
          rotate: interpolate(t.dx, [-widget.width, 0, widget.width], [deg(-15), 0, deg(15)]),
        );
      case 1:
        final pull = interpolate(t.dx.abs(), [0, widget.width / 2], [0, 1], Extrapolation.clamp);
        return AnimatedStyle(scale: 0.92 + 0.08 * pull, translateY: 18 * (1 - pull));
      default:
        return const AnimatedStyle(scale: 0.92, translateY: 18);
    }
  });

  late final likeStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => AnimatedStyle(
        opacity: widget.depth == 0
            ? interpolate(widget.translation.value.dx, [0, widget.width / 4], [0, 1], Extrapolation.clamp)
            : 0,
      ));
  late final nopeStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => AnimatedStyle(
        opacity: widget.depth == 0
            ? interpolate(widget.translation.value.dx, [-widget.width / 4, 0], [1, 0], Extrapolation.clamp)
            : 0,
      ));

  Widget _stamp(String text, Color color, AnimatedStyleHandle style, double angle) => AnimatedView(
        style: Styles([AnimatedStyle(rotate: angle), style]),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 4),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            border: Border.all(color: color, width: 4),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
          ),
          child: Text(text, style: TextStyle(fontSize: 30, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: color)),
        ),
      );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AnimatedView(
        style: Styles([
          AnimatedStyle(width: widget.width, height: widget.width * 1.3, backgroundColor: widget.color, borderRadius: 24),
          style,
        ]),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              Row(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                children: [
                  _stamp('LIKE', const Color(0xFF1E9E6A), likeStyle, deg(-15)),
                  _stamp('NOPE', const Color(0xFFD9363E), nopeStyle, deg(15)),
                ],
              ),
              const Spacer(),
              Text(widget.title, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 30, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: Palette.navy)),
              const SizedBox(height: 6),
              const Text('Swipe right to like, left to pass',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 15, color: Palette.navy)),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
}
```
